blocks.text: You can add discovery filters to privileged credentials to hone the credential results, sync external identity sources (e.g., Active Directory (AD) or Entra ID) to discover credentials in real time, and review the existing discovery filters.
To learn more about Privileged Remote Access (PRA), see Understanding Privileged Remote Access. To set up PRA, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Privileged Remote Access.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Credentials Management > Privileged Credentials > Discovered.

blocks.text: You can add a discovery filter from the Managed, Discovered, or Ignored tab.

blocks.item: Click Discover Credential.
The Discover Credentials drawer opens.
Click Add.

blocks.text: The Add Discovery Filter window appears.

blocks.item: In the Add Discovery Filter window:
Credential Provider: Select a credential provider that you want to add the discovery filter to.
Discovery: Enter a search query to use for the discovery filter.
Name: Enter a name for the discovery filter.
Click Submit.

blocks.text: In the Discover Credentials drawer, you can do the following:

blocks.item: Click the Filters icon to display or hide the filters.
Click the Search icon to locate specific information in the table.
Refresh the Discover Credentials window to reflect the most current information.
Add a discovery filter.
Click Sync Now to discover credentials using the existing discovery filters.
Filter the information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied. To learn more, see Using Tables.
View a list of all discovery filters. For each discovery filter, you can see:
Credential Provider: The credential provider for the discovered credential (e.g., Active Directory, Entra ID, etc.).
Name: The name of the discovered credential.
Discovery Filter: The filters used to discover the credential.
Discovered: The date, time, and time zone when the credential was discovered.
Status: The filters used to discover the credential.
Last Synced: The date, time, and time zone when the last credential pull from the credential provider occurred.
Scheduled Sync: The date, time, and time zone when the next credential pull from the credential provider occurs.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Click the Sync icon to discover credentials in real time.
Delete a discovery filter.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Click Close to close the drawer.
